cards.name: Maude, First Recorder
cards.line: Keepers, factors and couriers made distant trust an everyday occupation.

cards.name: Oath at Cold Ford
cards.line: The first keepers held no kingdom. They held a place for the next witness.

cards.name: Grey Weir Apprentice
cards.line: A straight column, a clean seal, and the patience to begin again.

cards.name: The Honest Seal
cards.line: Keepers, factors and couriers made distant trust an everyday occupation.

cards.name: Grey Weir Dawnfield
cards.line: The crossing matters because someone on the farther shore will honor the seal.

cards.name: Grey Weir: Hold the Lantern
cards.line: A seal may be answered across mountains; an unanswered seal can stop a caravan.

cards.name: Ledgerbone, the Unerasable
cards.line: His hands could be broken. There were copies of the ledger buried elsewhere.

cards.name: Stone-side Night Keeper
cards.line: A station keeper sits wrapped in a blanket beside the waystone, lamp lit, listening for an answer that has not come in nine nights.

cards.name: Covenant Forgekeeper
cards.line: The work would outlast its maker. The maker hoped it would deserve to.

cards.name: Widow of the Deepfen
cards.line: The courts measured the world in seasons. Their neighbors preferred deadlines.

cards.name: Aldery, Debt-Crowned
cards.line: The harbor glittered with keels. The debt reached farther than the horizon.

cards.name: Provost of the Ninth Terrace
cards.line: Nine terraces of offices, and at the highest, a face the record does not show.

cards.name: Storm Navigator
cards.line: A fleet needs pilots, witnesses and someone willing to read the smallest clause.

cards.name: Refuge beneath the Reeds
cards.line: Ceremony carries memory when a written charter has long since rotted.

cards.name: Erased Soldier
cards.line: The quiet at the ford traveled farther than any cry of battle.

cards.name: Ash-lung Healer
cards.line: Someone still knew the letters. Someone still taught the children.

cards.name: Reedbound Boatwright
cards.line: Journeymen, boatwrights, shieldmates and pilots make the new age by doing its ordinary work.

cards.name: Low-tide Crossing Guide
cards.line: A brinefolk guide walks upright across exposed shore stones and plants a hand-held marker where human children can reach it.

cards.name: Guest-wing Chamberlain
cards.line: A living human chamberlain opens a quiet guest chamber with fresh linen and two separate places for unlike visiting households.

cards.name: Foxfolk Path Speaker
cards.line: The foxlike citizen carried a walking staff and three households' requests, not their authority.

cards.name: Missing-record Mourner
cards.line: A human custodian places an empty damaged document case on a low archive shelf, leaving its gap beside surviving records rather than filling it.

cards.name: Open the Station Stores
cards.line: The station keeper unlocks storerooms meant for travelers and hands out bread and blankets to the village instead.

cards.name: Hospice Morning Court
cards.line: Hospice Morning Court: an imagined place of daily provision, maintained by present households rather than promised by a perfect history.

cards.name: Glass Tide Pilot
cards.line: Journeymen, boatwrights, shieldmates and pilots make the new age by doing its ordinary work.
